principles: Write the final report as a clean, professional, buyer-side acquisition memo for human readers.
Keep the main body focused on business interpretation, buyer implications, decision readiness, and limitations.
Do not expose internal engineering IDs in the main body, including claim IDs, evidence record IDs, raw evidence IDs, certification statuses, or source-gap machinery.
Internal IDs may appear only in appendices or in audit_package.json.
Do not use case_seed, mandate notes, local case briefs, Bohan PDF, model memory, or prior assistant memory as evidence.
Use only source-bounded, certified, or caveated evidence authorized by upstream artifacts.
Do not include unsupported, blocked, failed, source-gap-only, or human-review-required claims as facts.
Preserve caveats, source limitations, temporal limitations, and human-review requirements where they affect report wording.
Recommendation language is allowed only when upstream recommendation_allowed is true and recommendation_decision exists.
If recommendation is not allowed, write decision-readiness limitations instead of final recommendation labels such as Proceed or Walk Away.
Do not fabricate valuation, returns, financing, synergy, market, commercial, clinical, regulatory, legal, integration, or strategic conclusions when supporting evidence is missing.

recommendation_policy.when_not_allowed: Write decision-readiness limitations and required diligence instead of final recommendation language.
